I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Post-merger, enterprise pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most sales leaders don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.
